source.source_name: Financial Reporting System — IFRS financial statements (XBRL)
source.organization: NSSMC / Financial Reporting Collection Centre; XBRL International

parsing.notes: Documented. Parse UA MSFS XBRL facts (assets/equity/revenue/profit) per filing; key on EDRPOU + period. Confirm the exact open endpoint (NSSMC portal vs filings.xbrl.org) and entity-id scheme before implementation.

mapping_rules.financials: Per period: total_assets, equity, revenue, net_profit from UA MSFS XBRL (UAH).

fixture_requirements: documented-only: one IFRS reporter XBRL filing with balance sheet + income statement

live_test_plan.smoke: Resolve the open endpoint; fetch one filing; map UA MSFS facts to fields.
live_test_plan.full: Annual harvest of IFRS-reporter filings; join to EDR by EDRPOU.

blockers: Exact open-bulk endpoint and entity-id scheme to be confirmed (NSSMC portal / filings.xbrl.org).
Coverage limited to IFRS reporters (not all SMEs).
